WHERE n.`metadata.source` = $_q0 AND n.`metadata.score` >= $_q1 AND n.fullName STARTS WITH $_q2 AND n:Gold AND $_q3 IN n.tags AND toLower(n.fullName) CONTAINS $_q4 AND n.LEGACY IS NULL

NEO4J.query.Animal.labels:

NEO4J.groups.byProperty:
MATCH (n:Movie)
WITH n.released AS k0, count(n) AS a0
RETURN {k0: k0, a0: a0} AS row
ORDER BY k0 ASC
NEO4J.groups.aggregates:
MATCH (n:Movie)
WHERE n.released > $from
WITH n.released AS k0, count(n) AS a0, sum(CASE WHEN n.released < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a1, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN n.released > 2000 THEN n.released END), 0) AS a2, avg(n.released) AS a3, max(n.released) AS a4
WHERE a0 >= $_having0
RETURN {k0: k0, a0: a0, a1: a1, a2: a2, a3: a3, a4: a4} AS row
ORDER BY a0 DESC, k0 ASC
SKIP 1
LIMIT 2
NEO4J.groups.byPath:
MATCH (n:Movie)
MATCH (n)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(k1:Director)
WITH DISTINCT n, k1
WITH n.released AS k0, k1, count(n) AS a0
RETURN {k0: k0, k1: {props: properties(k1), labels: labels(k1)}, a0: a0} AS row
ORDER BY k0 DESC, k1.uuid ASC
